scope.summary: W4 external-client cases for oracle_compile_object, oracle_create_or_replace, oracle_patch_source, oracle_compile_errors, oracle_get_source and oracle_get_ddl (scripts/e2e/w4/cases/source-tools.json, 40 cases) green over stdio and Streamable HTTP on FREE 23ai, XE 21 and XE 18 with the release binary.
out_of_scope: ADB behaviour (T9.6a) and unlisted behaviours, per the bead's no-claim.

entry_points.name: W4 source-tools family, release binary (verifier re-execution)
entry_points.trace: Release binary (cargo build --release -p oraclemcp --bin oraclemcp) from a clean export of 12e16ecb; driver invoked with every source-tools case id: free23 80/80, xe21 80/80, xe18 80/80 (stdio + http), in-driver audit-chain verification passed. Acceptance negatives also pass alone on free23: w4_create_or_replace_refused_at_read_write, w4_patch_source_stale_preview_refused, w4_get_ddl_unsupported_type_invalid_arguments (INVALID_ARGUMENTS). Previously red blockers (nqauq, moad8, .8.2, .8.4) are closed and their cases now pass.

limitations: Tier-C runner was not used; each lane was driven directly with the scoped family (all ids) in one invocation, which exercises the same cases and transports.
W1 bypass-shape and W2 runtime cases for these tools belong to their own beads.
